<thought>To identify the correct retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for reactions that form a C‑C double bond and a carboxylic ester (the key features of the Still‑Gennari HWE reaction) while breaking a C‑P bond, a C‑O bond, and a C‑C bond. This should retrieve the template used to generate the precursors listed earlier. Once the template is found, I will retrieve its SMARTS and map the reaction to obtain the `mapped_rxn` string.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "carboxylic esters"],
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C-P", "C-O", "C-C"],
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
